blogPosts.title: Maintaining Your Gutter Guards in Hawthorn's Wet Winters
blogPosts.excerpt: Find out how to maintain gutter guards in Hawthorn during wet winters to ensure clear drainage and prevent water damage.
body: Hawthorn's wet winters bring heavy rainfall, making gutter maintenance essential even with guards installed. Regular checks ensure that debris doesn't accumulate on top of the guards, which could impede water flow and cause overflow issues.

Professional inspections, offered by companies like Grayson's Gutter Guard, are recommended at least twice a year in Hawthorn. These checks involve clearing any leaves or twigs that may have collected, verifying that mesh screens are intact, and ensuring downspouts are unblocked.

In Hawthorn, the mix of deciduous and evergreen trees means year-round debris potential, so during winter, focus on areas where branches overhang the roof. Trimming nearby trees can reduce the load on gutter guards and prevent damage during storms.

If you notice water pooling or slow drainage, it may indicate a blockage or misalignment, which should be addressed promptly to avoid fascia rot or foundation issues. Hawthorn's older homes are particularly susceptible, so timely maintenance is key.

Using a garden hose to flush the system can help identify problems, but for thorough cleaning, professional services are advised. They have the tools and expertise to handle Hawthorn's varied roof heights and gutter styles safely.

By maintaining your gutter guards in Hawthorn's wet winters, you extend their lifespan and protect your property from costly repairs, ensuring that your investment continues to provide reliable protection against the elements.
